title: Why People Misremember Confidence as Accuracy
short_teaser: A confident voice can feel more believable even when evidence is weak.
story: A confident voice can feel more believable even when evidence is weak. Certainty and correctness are different signals. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Certainty and correctness are different signals. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions.
